data.name: Veilscripture AI
data.detailed_description:
Your Private AI Roleplay Studio

Launch a character, settle into a story, and create your own worlds. Veilscripture is a comprehensive roleplay suite that runs entirely on your machine — no cloud, no subscription, no one watching. Just you and the story.

Stories That Remember

Veilscripture is built exclusively for roleplay. Characters hold onto what's happened. Conversations carry weight across sessions as you control. And if you want to hear your characters speak, built-in text-to-speech brings them to life. You may even turn entire chats into audiobooks or PDFs as you like and share them!

Build the Worlds You Want

Create characters from scratch with the built-in Card Manager, or design entire worlds with Veil Atlas and drop them into any story. When you've made something you're proud of, share it on Steam Workshop in one click.

No Setup. No Fiddling. Just Start.

No terminals, no configuration files, no troubleshooting. Veilscripture tunes itself to your hardware the moment you launch it. If you enjoy tinkering, advanced settings are there when you want them for finer control.

Private by Default

Your stories stay on your machine. Veilscripture doesn't phone home or collect data. All chats are encrypted at rest.

Want to continue a story from your phone or another device? Secure remote access keeps everything private through encrypted connections — no data ever touches a third-party server.

✅ Fully offline — no cloud, no subscription

✅ Built exclusively for roleplay — memory optimization, voice, world-building

✅ Complete privacy — no telemetry, no data collection, chat encryption

✅ Your worlds, your characters — export your story to text or audio, or share on Steam Workshop, or not

A note on content: Veilscripture currently filters explicit sexual content to comply with Steam's policy on AI-generated material. Flirting and non-sexual intimacy are unaffected. Our position is that what an adult does with a private tool on their own machine should be their choice; if Steam's policy evolves, Veilscripture will follow.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen7 5700X3D/Intel Core i7‑9700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: None
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires 64-bit system. The CPU must have at least 8 physical cores for smooth AI experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX GeForce 3060ti 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires 64-bit system. The CPU must have at least 8 physical cores for smooth AI experience. If you wish to bring your own models, your hardware needs to fulfill the corresponding requirements.

content_descriptors.notes: Some nudity and violence might appear in chat. Drug and alcohol abuse might appear in AI generated texts. Any sexual assault/non-consensual sexual content, or self-harm content will be blocked internally.
